pickRomHelp: Choose your own dump of A Link to the Past (.sfc/.smc). It never leaves this device.
unsupportedRom: This ROM is not a supported A Link to the Past dump.
name: Name
modeZeldaHelp: Peaceful. Cannot fight or be hurt.

errors.version_mismatch: You and the host have different app versions
errors.invalid_name: Names are 1-16 letters, digits, spaces, - or _

controls.title: Controls
controls.help: Click any key or gamepad button to change it, then press the new one. Esc cancels.
controls.stick: A gamepad's left stick also moves Link.

hostHelp: Your browser runs the room. Invite friends on your local network (or Radmin/Hamachi) with a code; keep this tab open while they play.
joinHelp: Join a friend's room with the invite code they send you.

invite.title: Invite friends
invite.step1: 1. Friends scan this room QR code (or open the link). It works for everyone, for as long as you host.
invite.step2: 2. Each friend then shows you their code: scan or paste it here

states.waiting: let them scan this answer code (Join screen)
states.failed: could not connect: are you on the same network?

invite.addressHelp: Only if friends can't connect: your LAN or Radmin/Hamachi IP, e.g. 26.12.34.56. Make a new code after typing it.
invite.qrHelp: A phone camera opens the game ready to join; friends pick their cartridge, name and path first.
invite.localOnly: This page is open as localhost, so the link only works on this computer. Open it by its network address (e.g. https://192.168.0.10:8443) to share it.
invite.scanHelp: Point the camera at the QR code
invite.noCamera: No camera available: paste the code instead

join.title: Join a room
join.step1: 1. Show this QR code to the host (they scan it in Invite), or send them the code
join.step2: 2. Scan or paste the host's answer
join.linkHelp: Pick your name and path, then press Join.

connect.need_invite: Not in a room yet: open Join and show your code to the host
connect.waiting_accept: Show your code to the host, then scan their answer
connect.host_gone: Disconnected from the host: ask for a new invite code
connect.connect_failed: Could not reach the host: same network? Try typing an address
connect.bad_code: That is not a valid code
connect.wrong_kind: That is the other kind of code (invite vs reply)

appearance.title: Link's colors
appearance.help: Changes apply right away, and everyone in the room sees your colors. Mail upgrades still change the tunic; pick again to override them.
